entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3501215734352781440: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 61359: distance 44.663 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.008), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 44.663 +/- 0.357 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 22.0049 +/- 0.2333 mas (same row, RUWE 3.09), 94.3 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 1.116, -56.704 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3501215734352781440 (quality A), from 2015A&A...574A..50J; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 15.565 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 61359: radius 15.565 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 160.862 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.049) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5214 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 61359: effective temperature 5214 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.037).
